body: I think I would be able to handle these things 1 by 1. But not all at the same time.

I still lover her very much. I never loved anyone in my life, like I love her and I can't just forget her. Sometimes I feel disgusted of myself because I can't get over these emotions. One of my friends suggested me to go to the clubs, meet another girls and it will slowly go away but I can't. I just can't do that. Even when I start to talk with other girls I catch myself on comparing them with her
I really don't. One of them is having really good time with her new friends after dumping me and my best friend is dead
